messages:
Sofia G: Heads-up: found 23 invoices with duplicate refund lines after the billing run. Window 2026-03-20 02:10-02:28 UTC. Looks like refunds for plan downgrades were applied twice.

Ben W: Any manual DLQ replays during that window?

Sofia G: Ops ran a small DLQ redrive around 02:18 (ticket BILL-4304).

Ashwin: Quick check: our webhook replayer sometimes drops X-Idempotency-Key when reconstructing events. Consumer dedupe uses idempotency_key + stripe_event_id, so missing header => duplicate processing.

Billing Bot: [alert] invoice-sync job billing-nightly FAILED at 2026-03-20T02:29:10Z. Logs: /logs/billing/2026-03-20/02

Sofia G: Log snippet shows two NetSuite refund calls for same stripe_ref ch_9Z8Y7:

```
2026-03-20T02:16:42Z INFO billing-worker createRefund {"cust":"cust_321","amount":-25,"meta":{"stripe_ref":"ch_9Z8Y7"}}
2026-03-20T02:16:43Z INFO billing-worker createRefund response 200 id=ns_1401
2026-03-20T02:17:05Z INFO billing-worker createRefund {"cust":"cust_321","amount":-25,"meta":{"stripe_ref":"ch_9Z8Y7"}}
2026-03-20T02:17:06Z INFO billing-worker createRefund response 200 id=ns_1402
```

Ben W: Can you confirm DB?

Sofia G: Ran quick query: SELECT count(*) FROM billing_events WHERE stripe_event_id='evt_dup_321' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-20 02:10' AND '2026-03-20 02:30'; -- returns 2

Ashwin: Confirmed. One billing_events row has idempotency_key null. Root cause: replayer code path for rate-limited batches used a different serializer that omitted headers.

Ben W: Short-term mitigation: pause DLQ redrives and add a guard to replayer to preserve headers. Ops SRE, can you pause?

Ops SRE: Paused DLQ redrives at 02:45 UTC. Added temporary guard requiring X-Idempotency-Key on replays.

Sofia G: Remediation plan: 1) enumerate affected invoices (time window + duplicated stripe_refs) 2) produce CSV with ns ids + invoice_num + duplicate_ref_id + amount 3) Finance to approve voiding duplicate NS refunds (prefer void) 4) run dry-run then live voids and reconcile ledger. I made a sheet: https://go/gdoc/dup-refunds-2026-03-20 (internal).

Billing Bot: [info] recon-dryrun created 23 candidates total $575. Artifact: /artifacts/2026-03-20/dup-refund-dryrun-2169004321.csv

Finance Lead: Please include a customer-impact column and flag >$50 amounts. I will review and approve after Sofia uploads.

Ashwin: Will push a hotfix to the replayer to always copy headers and add unit/integration tests. Filed infra#5510. Also adding a backfill to flag billing_events with null idempotency_key for manual review.

Ben W: After patch, add a regression test that runs a DLQ replay and asserts no duplicate NetSuite calls.

Sofia G: Uploaded CSV and notified CS for >$50 cases. Waiting on Finance ack before running voids.

Ops SRE: Leaving DLQ paused until patch deploys and CI passes. Added runbook note 'billing/dlq-redrive-preserve-headers'.

Sofia G: Thanks team. Will follow up once Finance approves and voids are applied. :white_check_mark:
